'''2012 Alderaan Regionals Ganden Yanaga DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2012 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
